competency_fulfillment.rationale: Only seed 55's "Shade 1/2 of the shape." is a genuine illustrate/construct task; the other seven samples, e.g. "A shape is divided into 2 equal parts. 1 part is shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?", ask the student to read and name a fraction from an already-shaded model rather than illustrate one.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Seeds 42, 43, 46, and 72 all render the identical "A shape is divided into 2 equal parts. 1 part is shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?" item, and seeds 44/45 duplicate the quarter-shaded version, leaving only two distinct content templates plus seeds 50 and 55 across eight samples.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Sentence structure stays plain and short throughout, e.g. "A shape is divided into 4 equal parts. 1 part is shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?", well matched to Grade 1 Q4 reading level.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formatter shells vary (mcq, cloze, read_mcq, set_click) but the underlying visual model is always 'a shape divided into equal parts, one shaded' with no alternate concrete model (e.g. grouped objects) ever appearing.

competency_alignment.rationale: Every sample stays strictly on 1/2 or 1/4 with no drift to another fraction or an unrelated axis, matching the competency's exact scope.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Only the two named fractions, 1/2 and 1/4, ever appear as targets across all eight samples, with no unrelated fraction like 1/3 introduced.
